about: The Sims's parts, in the order a player meets them, then its other modes. Each counts the same, and each is a task of the game's version in C: the functions the original runs in it that no part before it runs, each with its proof, and a recording that plays it from its first frame to its last with every frame matching the original. "frames" are the first and last of the recording's frames it covers. A part may end with a press that moves the game on, the way a player leaves it, such as Start on the title screen. Where the screen is one colour between two parts, those frames go with the part before. Get a Life's later homes go by their order here until someone has played far enough to name them.
